question: Amit had invested the same amount of sums at simple as well as compound interest, compounded annually. The time period of investment for both the sums was 2 years and rate of interest too was same, 4% per annum. At the end, he found a difference of ₹44 in both the interests received. What were the sums (in ₹) invested?
solution:

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹44
